patterns.name: Three Tier Web Application
patterns.flow: User -> DNS/CDN/WAF -> Load Balancer/API Gateway -> App/API tier -> Database/Cache -> Observability
patterns.blank_prevention: If service detail is missing, select managed load balancer, managed compute, managed database, managed secrets and managed monitoring for the selected cloud.

patterns.name: Microservices Platform
patterns.flow: Client -> API Gateway -> Microservices on Kubernetes/serverless -> Event Bus -> Databases -> Monitoring
patterns.blank_prevention: Use container or serverless mapping from provider catalog and include image scanning, service identity, network policy and central logs.

patterns.name: Enterprise Data Lakehouse
patterns.flow: Sources -> Landing/Raw zone -> Processing -> Curated zone -> Warehouse/Semantic layer -> BI/AI consumption
patterns.blank_prevention: Always include landing/raw/curated/consumption zones, DQ checks, lineage, access control, encryption and retention.

patterns.name: Event Driven Processing
patterns.flow: Producer -> Topic/Event Bus -> Consumer Function/Container/Dataflow -> Target API/Database/Warehouse
patterns.blank_prevention: Include schema validation, retry, DLQ, idempotency and replay handling.

patterns.name: Batch ETL/ELT Pipeline
patterns.flow: Scheduler -> Orchestrator -> Extract -> Stage -> Transform -> Validate -> Publish
patterns.blank_prevention: Include SLA window, retry/backfill, idempotency, reconciliation and DQ controls.

patterns.name: Retrieval Augmented Generation
patterns.flow: Sources -> Parse -> Chunk -> Embed -> Vector Store/Index -> Retrieve/Re-rank -> LLM -> Grounded Response
patterns.blank_prevention: If vector store is missing, select provider-native vector search or database with vector capability and include ACL filters.

patterns.name: Agentic AI Workflow
patterns.flow: User/UI -> Agent Planner -> Tool Router -> RAG/API/Workflow Tools -> Policy Guard -> Final Response/Action
patterns.blank_prevention: Include tool allowlist, state management, retry limit, idempotency, prompt/tool audit and human approval for high-risk actions.

patterns.name: Hybrid / Multi-Cloud Connectivity
patterns.flow: Source network -> Private connectivity/VPN/Interconnect/Direct Connect/ExpressRoute -> Cloud network -> Private endpoints/services
patterns.blank_prevention: Always include CIDR validation, BGP/routing, DNS resolution, firewall allowlist, encryption, monitoring and data residency.
